scope: intermediate standard rows before direction generation; pre-despill chroma is not final chroma QA
identity: Consistent silver-haired blue-eyed 2D Kallen in white dress, black-red jacket and braid across all nine rows.

states.idle: Six quiet open-eye breathing/small head-and-cloth variations; feet planted, no greeting or work gesture.
states.running-right: Eight right-facing alternating leg poses with braid/tie follow-through and readable gait.
states.running-left: Eight separately generated left-facing alternating gait poses; not a mirrored costume.
states.waving: Four-frame attached hand greeting with lift, wave and lowering.
states.jumping: Five-frame crouch, ascent, apex, descent and settle; final feet baselines 203,190,164,181,203 preserve a real rise/return with common row scale.
states.failed: Eight-frame sad/deflated head and shoulder response and recovery, distinct from neutral.
states.waiting: Expectant palm-out request with attentive face, distinct from wave and chin inspection.
states.running: Standing focused chest-level activity with planted feet, not foot-running.
states.review: Downward/side inspecting glance with thoughtful hand motion and nod; no new props.

warnings: Jump deliberately uses stable-slots because component fitting erased source vertical motion; full separated source and all five extracted cells inspected, no neighbor debris or clipping.
final_chroma_review: deferred to the single completed-v2 despill and validator
